tool_args.rationale: The slow-horizon probe observed a reversal from positive to negative, matching the archived endogenous adaptation mechanism. Fit all four parameters numerically and test the resulting law on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Positive short-horizon gain followed by a negative long-horizon response is incompatible with the listed monotone forms.
All observations have zero sink gradient; the linear-in-input dual-horizon law is the simpler identified candidate.
The acquired short- and long-horizon observations span the reversal and support fitting the four-parameter candidate before buying more measurements.
